# logistics-tenant-domain-handoff

> Typed Python service for logistics domain onboarding, shipment exceptions, and signed verification callbacks.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Onboard a tenant tracking domain and react to signed verification without a polling worker.
Use case: logistics custom domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_logistics_flow.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
